note: Nested inclusive timings must not be added. Exclusive timings subtract nested scopes. Only exited scopes are included; failed/paused calls also count. Restore continues cumulative totals without counting downtime or state reconstruction. environment_step includes physical execution and queue waiting. policy_prediction includes observation/mask preparation and epsilon-random choices, which need no NN forward. online_forward includes both action inference and training forwards; target_forward is the TD-target forward. replay_store/sample are buffer insertion/sampling only. adam_step excludes backward/clip. training_update_total includes forward/backward/clipping/diagnostics and Replay sampling; its calls equal Adam updates only for the fixed one-update-per-call runner on successful updates. validation_executor includes validation_prediction (Greedy selection plus NN inference). report_write measures Validation CSV/JSON writes only; checkpoint_write measures model, Replay and state serialization, excluding the subsequent JSON markers and performance file.
